description_en: Queries the worker tasks of a deployment task. Each worker task deploys a certificate to a specific cloud resource in a cloud service
description_zh: 阿里云支持批量部署证书，因此一个部署任务中可能对应多个云产品子任务（Worker），对应每个产品中的资源实例，您可通过该接口查看Worker任务详细信息
name: ListWorkerResource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task from the ID parameter. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712223.html operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task
parameters.help_zh: 部署任务ID。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html返回的任务**ID**。也可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712223.html接口获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the worker task.

Valid values:

rollback

rollback_error

success

rollback_success

pending

scheduling

processing

error

editing
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The cloud service in the deployment task
parameters.help_zh: 部署任务中对应的云产品
parameters.name: cloud_product

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页，设置每页展示的任务个数，默认50
parameters.name: show_size

CertDomain.title_zh: 部署任务Worker证书域名，与UserCert/CertOrder值一致

CertId.title_zh: 部署任务Worker CertId，与UserCert值一致

CertInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the certificate in the worker task

CertInstanceId.title_zh: 部署任务Worker证书实例ID，与UserCert/CertOrder值一致

CloudName.description_en:
The cloud service provider to which the cloud resource in the worker task belongs.

This parameter is not returned if you deploy certificates to Alibaba Cloud services
CloudName.description_zh:
Worker任务云产品资源所属云厂商。
部署至阿里云的云产品默认不返回该参数
CloudName.title_en: 部署任务Worker云资源所属云厂商，与CloudResource值一致
CloudName.title_zh: 部署任务Worker云资源所属云厂商，与CloudResource值一致

CloudProduct.description_en:
The cloud service to which the cloud resource in the worker task belongs. Valid values:

CDN: Alibaba Cloud CDN (CDN). This value is supported only at the China site (aliyun.com).

SLB: Classic Load Balancer (CLB). This value is supported only at the China site (aliyun.com).

DCDN: Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN). This value is supported only at the China site (aliyun.com).

DDOS: Anti-DDoS. This value is supported only at the China site (aliyun.com).

LIVE: ApsaraVideo Live. This value is supported only at the China site (aliyun.com).

webHosting: Cloud Web Hosting. This value is supported only at the China site (aliyun.com).

VOD: ApsaraVideo VOD. This value is supported only at the China site (aliyun.com).

CR: Container Registry. This value is supported only at the China site (aliyun.com).

ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB).

APIGateway: API Gateway.

FC: Function Compute.

GA: Global Accelerator (GA).

MSE: Microservices Engine (MSE).

NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB).

OSS: Object Storage Service (OSS).

SAE: Serverless App Engine (SAE).

TencentCDN: Tencent Cloud Content Delivery Network (CDN).

WAF: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
CloudProduct.description_zh:
Worker任务中云资源所属云产品。
CDN：内容分发网络（仅中国站）
SLB：传统型负载均衡CLB（仅中国站）
DCDN：全站加速（仅中国站）
DDOS：DDos防护（仅中国站）
LIVE：视频直播（仅中国站）
webHosting：云虚拟主机（仅中国站）
VOD：视频点播（仅中国站）
CR：容器镜像服务（仅中国站）
ALB：应用负载均衡
APIGateway：API网关
FC：函数计算
GA：全球加速
MSE：微服务引擎
NLB：网络型负载均衡
OSS：对象存储
SAE：Serverless 应用引擎
TencentCDN：腾讯CDN
WAF：Web应用防火墙
CloudProduct.title_en: 部署任务Worker云资源所属云产品，与CloudResource值一致
CloudProduct.title_zh: 部署任务Worker云资源所属云产品，与CloudResource值一致

CloudRegion.description_en: The original region ID of the cloud resource in the worker task. The value is the region ID defined by the cloud service provider. This parameter is required only when you deploy certificates to services of multiple clouds
CloudRegion.description_zh: Worker任务云产品资源原始地域ID（云厂商的RegionID）。仅多云部署会返回
CloudRegion.title_en: 部署任务Worker云资源原始RegionID（云厂商的RegionID），与CloudResource值一致
CloudRegion.title_zh: 部署任务Worker云资源原始RegionID（云厂商的RegionID），与CloudResource值一致

DefaultResource.description_en:
Indicates whether the cloud resource in the worker task is the default resource. Valid values:

true

false

This parameter is returned only when the value of CloudProduct is SLB, NLB, ALB, or GA
DefaultResource.description_zh:
Worker任务云产品资源是否为”默认资源“。

true：默认资源
false：非默认资源
仅部署SLB、NLB、ALB和GA才会返回该参数
DefaultResource.title_en: 部署任务Worker云资源是否为“默认资源”，与CloudResource值一致
DefaultResource.title_zh: 部署任务Worker云资源是否为“默认资源”，与CloudResource值一致

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the worker task was created. The time is a timestamp in seconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: Worker任务创建时间（秒，时间戳格式）
